documents.instruction: Keep the three-part Ster contract exact: final-token residual capture, contrastive direction learning/evaluation, and additive generation intervention; preserve product boundaries and link every corpus section.
Keep the no-network toy-model happy path executable with current CLI flags; captured console output must never be fabricated and must only be replaced by newly captured output.
Complete reference for every subcommand, flag, default, stream, output shape, and exit behavior in the Rust CLI.
Complete loopback HTTP contract: lifecycle, every endpoint/request field/default, error envelope, NDJSON event, serialization rule, and concurrency boundary; captured output must never be fabricated.
List every public Rust symbol and exact behavior exposed through the crate's public modules and root re-exports; remove symbols that leave source.
Keep module ownership, data flows, persistence, trust boundaries, concurrency, and external product boundaries traceable to source.
Enumerate every CLI and serve key/default, Cargo feature, effective runtime environment/file knob, model-config boundary, and repository release key; do not invent an application config file.

Track every source-authored refusal and wrapper sentence exactly, grouped by failure point with meaning and operator fix; include complete serve pre-job validation and stream-vs-HTTP failure behavior.

Executed offline train/optimize/evaluate/generate/extract/inspect walkthrough; never fabricate console output or semantic meaning for the random toy model, and only replace captures by rerunning the same real path.
Executed loopback health/validation/train/generate/refusal/404 session; retain exact captured JSON and NDJSON unless the real session is recaptured.
PairSet noun: complete JSON shape, file-order lifecycle, invariants, exact refusals, and guidance that prevents confounds.
Activation noun: exact after-block pre-steering final-token read point, F32 width, lifecycle, export schema, and refusals.
Direction/steering-vector noun: shape, normalization, sign convention, scores, intervention lifecycle, and all width/finiteness invariants.
Keep CAA, PCA, and logistic algorithms, constants, aliases, normalization, optimize relationship, and exact refusals identical to source.
Layer-selection noun: exact zero-based half-open grammar, sorting/deduplication, command use, runtime bounds, and refusal sentences.
Evaluation noun: exact strict-positive pair accuracy and mean-margin formulas, train/optimize/evaluate semantics, output shape, and limitations.
SteeringArtifact schema field by field, defaults, lifecycle, validation and model gates, metadata behavior, and exact refusal sentences.
Intervention noun: exact insertion point/order, every-step application, signed strength, plan construction, artifact gates, sampling interaction, and limitations.
Exact local-vs-Hub branch, file discovery/exclusions, revision identity, hf-hub cache/token behavior, Llama architecture gate, device selection, and refusals.
Index only existing runnable offline examples and current flags; point to the two recorded walkthroughs and never claim semantic quality for random weights.
Keep the offline seeded checkpoint generator aligned with every tensor name and Llama config field the current runtime loads; stdlib only, deterministic, no network.
Preserve the exact eight-pair input used by captured walkthroughs and keep every token within the toy vocabulary; changing it requires recapturing dependent outputs.
Preserve the exact two-prompt extraction input used by captured walkthroughs and keep every token within the toy vocabulary; changing it requires recapturing dependent output.
